:::{#def-mechanistic-view}

#### Mechanistic view of causation

On the **mechanistic view**,
$A$ causes $B$ if
there is a mechanism,
an organized set of entities and activities,
that links $A$ to $B$.
This gloss builds on Machamer, Darden, and Craver's account of mechanisms
[@machamer2000thinking],
which analyzes mechanistic explanation
and does not define causation itself.

:::
